auth.default_user.password_hash.description: Password hash for the default user (e.g., MD5 hex).

auth.method.description: Authentication method: 'md5', 'plain', 'scram-sha-256', or 'external'. Only 'md5' is supported by default config structure for passwordCheck field.

connection.channels_max.description: Maximum number of channels per connection.

queue_max_messages_in_ram.description: Maximum number of messages kept in RAM per shard.

server.listen.description: IP and port to bind the AMQP listener (e.g., 127.0.0.1:5672 or [::]:5672).
